items.title: FOOTBALL GAMEDAY: #MACtion Slate Continues: Cardinals and Bobcats Take Tuesday Stage in Athens
Ball State Looks to Improve Red Zone Execution Ahead of Road Matchup at Ohio
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- Ball State football continues its midweek #MACtion schedule Tuesday night as the Cardinals travel to Ohio for a challenging road matchup against the Bobcats. Head coach Mike Uremovich, Donovan Hamilton and Jared Badie met with the media Friday to discuss the upcoming contest and the team's focus following Wednesday's loss to Buffalo.

items.title: Cardinals Fall to Bulls at Rainy Scheumann
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- After a 10-minute weather delay to open Wednesday night's midweek #MACtion game, the Cardinals suffered its second loss at home in 2026, falling to Buffalo 28-7.

Football Looks to Host Buffalo in Second Week of Midweek MACtion
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- Ball State football enters its second midweek MACtion matchup of the season looking to host Buffalo, following an overtime loss Wednesday night at UMass. Head coach Mike Uremovich, Jalen Bonds and Stu Smith joined the media Friday morning to discuss another conference battle.

items.title: TOGETHER (Ball State Sports Link Docuseries): Episode 5
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- For the second straight year, Ball State Football has teamed with on-campus partner Ball State Sports Link to present a weekly documentary series that chronicles the season of head coach Mike Uremovich and the 2026 Cardinals.
